# rgpycrumbs

> Dispatcher-based analytical and visualization suite for chemical physics: eOn NEB/min/saddle plots, analytic surfaces, geometry, ORCA helpers, Click CLI.

Docs: https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/rgpycrumbs
PyPI / conda-forge: rgpycrumbs
Context7: /haozeke/rgpycrumbs

Use the public `rgpycrumbs` surface and the Click CLI. Do not import private `_` modules.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/quickstart.html)
- [Install](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/howto/install.html)
- [eOn tools](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/index.html)
- [Tutorials](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/first-project.html)
- [Public API](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/explanation/public_api.html)

## Siblings

- [chemparseplot](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/): parse and plot chemistry outputs
- [pychum](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/): ORCA / eOn input generation

## Install

```sh
uv add rgpycrumbs
# or
pip install rgpycrumbs
```
